thread:
Ajay: Starting a config-only deploy for tonight's QoS changes (routing weights, batch/window shrink, timeouts). Canaries on. @deploy-bot please kick off.

deploy-bot: Config-only canary started on infra-qa-1 (cohort A). id cfg-roll-2246789012. Monitoring...

Maria: watching infra-qa-1 logs now. seeing a small 5xx blip at 02:12 UTC, digging.

Carl: what's the exact diff? paste please

Ajay: sure:
```
routing:
  primary_weight: 0.7 -> 0.6
batching:
  max_tokens: 4096 -> 2048
  batch_window_ms: 25 -> 10
timeouts:
  kv_cache_idle_s: 1200 -> 900
```
also reduced per-route concurrency 100 -> 60 for safety.

deploy-bot: Canary health: 3/3 hosts healthy, p50 latency +8ms, error_rate +0.4% :eyes:

Maria: error source: model runtime reported transient OOM on long-seq requests, 2 occurrences only. I requeued one request.

Sylvia: can we pin traffic back to previous config while we investigate? recommend rollback to snapshot `cfg-2024-11-07-1712` for 30m.

Ajay: agree. pausing rollout and pinning 50% traffic to cfg-2024-11-07-1712. @deploy-bot please apply pin and alert #incidents if rollback triggers.

deploy-bot: Pin applied: cohort A -> cfg-2024-11-07-1712. Rolling back canary cohort B in 30s.

Carl: note for release notes: 'tightened batch window caused minor OOMs on long sequences; reverted for nighttime operation.'

Ajay: I'll open a follow-up ticket and schedule a reattempt in the quiet window tomorrow 06:00 UTC. thanks all :thumbsup:
